items.q: Federal authorities' "failure meant that the State had to rely on the best — imperfect — data it had available to ensure that no Iowan’s vote was canceled by an illegal, noncitizen vote," Pate and Bird said in a joint statement.

record.t: Won re-election as Iowa Secretary of State, defeating Ryan Peterman in the November 3, 2026 general election.
record.q: Incumbent Paul Pate (R) defeated Ryan Peterman (D) in the general election for Iowa Secretary of State on November 3, 2026.

record.t: Provided Johnson County a list of 295 alleged non-citizens who had voted or registered to vote, with a directive to challenge the ballots of listed people who try to vote in the 2024 General Election.
record.q: On October 22, Secretary Pate provided a list of 295 alleged non-citizens who had voted or registered to vote in Johnson County, along with a directive to challenge the ballots of any person on the list who attempts to vote in the 2024 General Election.

record.t: Won re-election as Iowa Secretary of State, defeating Joel Miller in the November 8, 2022 general election.

record.t: Won re-election as Iowa Secretary of State, defeating Deidre DeJear and Jules Ofenbakh in the November 6, 2018 general election.
record.q: Incumbent Paul Pate (R) defeated Deidre DeJear (D) and Jules Ofenbakh (L) in the general election for Iowa Secretary of State on November 6, 2018.

record.t: Announced that Iowa would provide only publicly available information to the Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity.
record.q: On July 1, Secretary Pate announced that the state would provide only publicly available information to the commission.

record.t: Assumed office as Iowa Secretary of State on January 1, 2015.
record.q: Paul Pate (Republican Party) is the Iowa Secretary of State. He assumed office on January 1, 2015.

record.t: Was unopposed for the Republican nomination in the June 3, 2014 primary and defeated Brad Anderson, Jake Porter and Spencer Highland in the November 4, 2014 general election for Iowa Secretary of State.
record.q: He was unopposed for the Republican nomination in the June 3 primary and defeated Brad Anderson (D), Jake Porter (L), and Spencer Highland (New Independent Party) in the general election on November 4, 2014.

record.t: Proposed a bill that would limit the grounds for challenging federal candidates to age, residency, citizenship and whether nominating papers meet legal requirements.
record.q: Pate’s proposal seeks to limit the grounds for challenging all federal candidates , including those running for president and Congress, to questions about age, residency, citizenship and whether their nominating papers meet all the legal requirements.

record.t: Filed a lawsuit with Attorney General Brenna Bird that claims USCIS would not hand over its list of noncitizens registered to vote in Iowa.
record.q: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird and Secretary of State Paul Pate filed the lawsuit on Tuesday, which claims U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) "would not hand over" its "list of noncitizens illegally registered to vote in Iowa.

record.t: Filed a bill that would prevent legal challenges attempting to remove Donald Trump from the 2024 ballot under the 14th Amendment.
record.q: A bill filed by Iowa Republican Secretary of State Paul Pate would prevent any legal challenges attempting to remove former President Donald Trump from the 2024 ballot under the 14th Amendment
